messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: increased model-load failures and OOMs in prod-us-west-2 cluster c-42. Error rate >= 8% for /v1/generate since 1747129940. Auto-escalation -> incidents channel.

oncall-alex: on it. assigning to ravi for runtime triage, anya for infra support. tagging eng-runtime and eng-infra.

ravi: taking. quick checks: k8s node pressure in c-42, several pods showing CrashLoopBackOff during model warmup. logs show deserialization + CUDA alloc failures.

anya: reassigning extra capacity from standby pool, spinning up 3 warm spare nodes in us-west-2.

liz: customer-impact? any 500s externally?

support-jake: Support telemetry: ~5 customers reported 500s/latency spikes. Percent of affected requests ~0.9% overall but concentrated on model-heavy routes. No billing impact reported.

ravi: logs excerpt:
```
2025-06-12T15:26:40Z model_warmup: loading shard 0 -> deserialize artifact
runtime: serde: checksum ok
runtime: cuda: cuMemAlloc failed: out of memory (0x7e)
stack: src/runtime/kernels/cuda_alloc.cc:312
error: model_init failed, will retry
```

ravi: repro pattern: larger 30B model hits deserialization then immediate cuMemAlloc when allocating KV cache+weights. Node-level GPU memory fragmentation observed. compile-time logs show intermittent nvrtc timeouts but main cause is OOM on allocation.

ops-sre: looks like warmup stampede + fragmented GPU memory. nodes with multiple concurrent warmups hit OOM. runbook step 3 suggests serializing warmups, but we don't have gating enabled for this model.

oncall-alex: mitigation plan (short): 1) disable concurrent warmup for model redwood-30b-prod on cluster c-42, 2) enable fallback routing to redwood-8b-quant for new requests, 3) cordon + drain 2 worst nodes, 4) trigger rolling restart of model-loading service with patched backoff.

ravi: implementing patch: set env REDWOOD_WARMUP_CONCURRENCY=1 for the deployment and increase model-load backoff to 30s. also pushing a hotfix to abort warmup earlier on alloc failure to avoid thrash.

anya: spare nodes are up, routing table updated to include w-standby pool. autoscaler bumped desired GPU nodes +2.

liz: product note: enabling fallback will change latency/quality for some customers. Maria FYI for comms.

product-maria: noted. prepping short customer message: degraded latency/occasional reduced top-1 quality for some models while we mitigate. no data loss.

ravi: applied hotfix, restarted 4 pods with graceful drain. logs now show warmup aborted early and fallback model used for inflight:
```
INFO model_load: warmup aborted on OOM, handing off to fallback redwood-8b-quant
INFO router: routing 18/24 new requests to fallback pool
```

oncall-alex: cordoned nodes n-0a, n-0b and drained warmup pods. will monitor paging/eviction rates.

ops-sre: after cordon, GPU memory fragmentation reduced on remaining nodes. eviction rate down 72% vs peak.

support-jake: customer reports: two customers still seeing brief 502 spikes, now resolved after fallback routing. I've sent status update to affected customers.

ravi: follow-ups: 1) schedule a model warmup gating rollout so heavy models can't warm concurrently on same node; 2) add kernel to abort compile on nvrtc timeout earlier; 3) improve artifact streaming to reduce peak memory during deserialize.

liz: create postmortem? severity P1 -> yes. include timeline, mitigation, and customer comms. assign editors: ravi + anya + liz.

product-maria: comms drafted, will send after postmortem sync.

oncall-alex: last check: error rate back to baseline ~0.2%, new requests routing 85% to primary models, 15% fallback during cool-down window. marking as mitigated but keeping channel open for 2h. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident status -> mitigated at 1747132150, severity P1, responders: ravi, anya, ops-sre, liz, alex.

ravi: adding notes to runbook and opening ticket INF-3421 for warmup-gating work.

support-jake: I'll follow up with customers and close tickets once they confirm no further errors.

oncall-alex: thanks team. we'll do a brief postmortem sync in 1h and publish notes. :coffee:
